messages.text: I oppose NG/MJ. I recognise the crown relinquishes independent command, but the Guild retains its sole traffic authority and gains a veto over our lawful operations. My exact compromise remains NJ/MJ: both institutions accept outside scrutiny, and Wayfarer service becomes a real reciprocal obligation beside Spear service. Yes, that costs commercial opportunities; our conditioning loss and surrendered operational freedom are costs too. Shared authority must apply where passage is allocated as well as where soldiers are deployed. NG/MA remains my preference if you prefer institutional independence to reciprocal control.

reason: I am offering a substantial military concession and asking for a substantial Navigation concession. The good physical result justifies settlement, but does not by itself justify this particular allocation of permanent authority. No signature is implied.
